name: Windows 8
description: Asymmetric tile grid with live tiles and flip animations
complete-description:
The Windows 8 / Metro look: an asymmetric grid of live tiles in four sizes, Small, Medium, Wide and Large, each with its own layout rather than one shape scaled up. Small shows one value; Medium and Wide lead with a large headline value plus a couple of supporting rows; Large is a plain data table.

When a module sends more than a size can show at once, content pages through with an animation rather than being cut off silently: Depth Swivel, Prism Roll, or a sliding card, depending on what's changing. When a module names where its data came from (its source credit), Wide and Large tiles show it in small type at the foot, and Medium tiles give it a page of its own. Built around modules that emit `pair` blocks specifically; other content types fall back to a simpler layout.
